$comment: Authored ledger of Lyra-only public names that change across a major release. Each profile drives lyra-ui-migrate --origin=<origin>, the generated llms/migration.md section and the packaged dist/cli/migration-contract.json. renames and reviews must each match an implemented, deprecated Lyra-only member and its component-metadata.json record (removalNotBefore in aliasRemovalMajor, since no later than toMajor.0.0 or 'unreleased'); defaults, detailChanges and slotContent record changes that have no member deprecation record, and a slotContent entry for a slot whose content carries a slot-content record keeps exactly that record's permittedContent as allow. check-migration-coverage.mjs also requires every Lyra-only deprecation removed in aliasRemovalMajor to have a rename or review entry (a slotContent entry for a slot-content record). Entries stay sorted by tag and name. See docs/rfcs/0003-lyra-v21-migration-profile.md.

slotContent.summary: Only items, labels and separators belong in the menu list; move other content to slot="header" or slot="footer", which render it outside role="menu".
